component.name: Terminal
component.summary: Run commands in a secure terminal

description.p: Terminal is a desktop terminal emulator for local shells and remote SSH sessions, with tabs, split panes, and bounded scrollback.

ul.li: Run real local shell sessions through pseudoterminals.
Organize sessions with tabs, split panes, and detached windows.
Connect to SSH endpoints without storing passwords in app state.
Store eligible pinned output only through the desktop Secret Service.
